heading: Diploma and Certificate Programs
description: All programs are approved by CTEVT and designed to deliver practical, career-focused training that meets national and international industry standards.

cards.title: Diploma in Computer Engineering
cards.desc: Three-year CTEVT diploma covering programming, networking, database systems, and software development.

cards.title: Diploma in Civil Engineering
cards.desc: Comprehensive training in structural design, surveying, construction management, and AutoCAD.

cards.title: Diploma in Electrical Engineering
cards.desc: Covers power systems, electrical installation, industrial wiring, and renewable energy technologies.

cards.title: Diploma in Electronics & Communication
cards.desc: Telecommunications, digital electronics, microprocessors, and communication systems.

cards.title: Diploma in Architecture
cards.desc: Architectural drawing, building design, sustainable construction, and interior planning.

cards.title: Diploma in Health Assistant
cards.desc: Primary healthcare, community health, clinical practice, and emergency medical response.
